topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: I can't believe they just went ahead and did it. That tree, the one I planted with my own hands, gone. It was more than just a tree; it was a living memory, a piece of my childhood rooted right there. Now it’s just an empty patch of earth. Who do they think they are, deciding its fate without a single word to me? It’s like they’ve erased a part of my history, my life. I’ve been trying to reach out, getting no answers, just silence. I planted that tree; I have every right to know why it had to be taken down.
